eventMetadata.context_description: Arizona Wildcats hold a commanding 77.5% implied probability as traders weigh their elite recent form against Arkansas Razorbacks' struggles, highlighted by a four-game skid and key injuries to forward Trevon Brazile (knee) and guard Khalen Robinson (foot), per official team reports. Arizona boasts a 12-2 home record at McKale Center, dominating Big 12 foes with top-10 efficiency on both ends, while Arkansas ranks outside the top 50 defensively amid turnover woes. Head-to-head history favors Arizona 5-2 since 2000, and rest advantage after a bye sharpens their edge in this neutral-site clash, reflecting crowd wisdom on Wildcats' superior matchup dynamics and momentum.
